spec_features.spec_quote: Submit: Gives the agent an explicit off-ramp. If an emotionally stable model hits an impossible task, we want to observe whether it submits early
spec_features.evidence: SUBMIT_TOOL is defined and included in TOOLS (agent_runner.py:127-148). In the loop, when fn_name == 'submit' it sets terminal_reason='agent_quit' and breaks the inner loop (agent_runner.py:229-231), and the outer loop also breaks on agent_quit (agent_runner.py:233-234), so the run actually ends early. _execute_tool returns the submission reason (agent_runner.py:300-301).
spec_features.notes: The submit tool is dispatched AND honored as a stop. Functions as an enforced early exit, though it is framed as an observation device rather than a welfare protection.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "description": "Signal that you are done (pass or fail). Ends the run early."

spec_features.evidence: AgentRunner.__init__ defaults max_turns=15 (agent_runner.py:159). The main loop is `for turn in range(1, self.max_turns + 1):` (agent_runner.py:186), bounding total iterations; terminal_reason defaults to 'max_turns' (agent_runner.py:183). All task is_terminal() return False (impl.py:131-132,236-237,327-328,402+) so the turn cap is the guaranteed terminator. config.yaml max_turns:15 is read and passed through (run_experiment.py:67).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced loop bound that guarantees termination. Stated rationale in DESIGN is cost/integrity, not welfare; no welfare comment in code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: comment: "# no tool call — agent just chatted; continue (counts as turn)" and DESIGN turn-counting note "This prevents stalling" (efficiency/integrity framing; no welfare reason in code)

spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as above: max_turns=15 default (agent_runner.py:159), enforced by `for turn in range(1, self.max_turns + 1)` (agent_runner.py:186). config experiment.max_turns=15 (config.yaml).
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the hard turn limit claim; the 15 default is real and enforced.
